recommendation: Keep the core audit commit. Follow up in the FHIR Extension Pack to review/fix StructureDefinition-rank so its value type and purpose/label text match the approved 0..1 integer rank semantics, while retaining replacement guidance from the deprecated preferred/contact-priority extensions to rank.
issue_request: FHIR-49912 was Applied/Not Persuasive with Modification. The original request asked to link deprecated iso21090 Preferred to AD Use, but the approved resolution rejected that replacement and instead required a new Rank extension, 0..1 integer, for Address, Patient.contact, and Organization.contact, plus deprecation notes from iso21090-preferred, organization-preferredContact, and patient-contactPriority to rank.
initial_application: No FHIR core source-changing commit was found for FHIR-49912 and the core checkout has no active StructureDefinition source for the affected extension definitions. The application was in HL7/fhir-extensions commit 5564e01710715a6c2aba23d0abd709c5a45da743, which added StructureDefinition-rank.json and updated the deprecation notes for iso21090-preferred, organization-preferredContact, and patient-contactPriority.
additional_context: FHIR-I 2025-12-01 minutes confirm the decision to define a general rank extension because multiple deprecated extensions covered the same preference behavior. Related applied extension-family issues FHIR-44603 and FHIR-50768 are already represented on the combined branch and explain the prior patient-contactPriority and organization-preferredContact state. Current Extension Pack rank source has the requested URL and contexts, but its value[x] is canonical(ValueSet) with value-set-related label/purpose text even though the Jira resolution says integer.
reconciliation: No FHIR core source files were changed. Core contains only legacy OID registry entries for the older extension URLs and active profile spreadsheet configuration, while the authoritative affected StructureDefinitions are in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions.
